description: Keywords a tracked competitor currently ranks for (last 7 days of SERP data), with difficulty and popularity per keyword. Pass own_app_id for gap analysis: keywords where the competitor ranks but your app doesn't are marked gap=missing. Cursor-paginated (default 50 per page). Requires an Indie plan (trial counts).

competitor_app_id.description: Sonar app UUID of the competitor — the `competitor.id` from sonar_track_competitor, or an `id` from sonar_list_apps where is_own is false. NOT a store id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Page size (1-200). Server default applies when omitted.

own_app_id.description: Sonar app UUID of your own app. When set, each keyword includes your current rank and a gap marker for keywords you don't rank for.

name: sonar_competitor_keywords
title: Competitor Keywords
